glosses: To make and administer the public policy and affairs of; to exercise sovereign authority in.

examples.text: The old king governed the land wisely.

glosses: To exercise political authority; to run a government.

examples.text: Americans are not libertarians in the Cato Institute sense of the word, but they are folk libertarians in this sense of impulsive behaviour, which is a feature of American life that anyone who wants to govern the United States, Democratic or Republican, has to be aware of.

examples.text: Govern yourselves like civilized people.

glosses: To exercise a deciding or determining influence on.

examples.text: Chance governs the outcome of many card games.
